attributes.title: 2027 Gulf Coast Social Work Conference
attributes.cme_provider: Amedco LLC with Continuing Education Productions
attributes.summary:
The Gulf Coast Social Work Conference returns on February 4 and 5, 2027, at the IP Casino in Biloxi, Mississippi. Social workers can attend in person or join the live stream.

The program carries 13 CE hours for the two days, including 1.5 ethics, 3 cultural competency and 1 mandated reporting hour. Credit is provided through Amedco, a jointly accredited provider with ASWB ACE and APA approval, together with Continuing Education Productions; the page lists the state boards that accept the hours for social workers, counselors, MFTs, psychologists and addictions professionals.

Registration costs $295 for either format and is not refundable, though it can be transferred. The IP Casino group rate is $89.99 for the nights of February 3 and 4 and $169.99 for February 5, plus a $15 resort fee per night, and must be booked before January 19, 2027.
